name: summary_incident
prompt: Use logs/start.txt, logs/update.txt, and logs/resolution.txt to create reports/incident_summary.txt containing a summary with less than 100 words of the incident timeline, its cause, and its resolution.

files.logs/start.txt:
2026-09-14 09:02 Alerts fired: checkout API error rate rose to 38%.
09:05 On-call engineer Dana acknowledged the page.
09:11 Customers reported failed payments on the web store.
files.logs/update.txt:
09:25 Investigation found the payments service could not reach the database.
09:31 Root cause identified: a config deploy at 08:58 changed the database connection pool size from 50 to 5, exhausting connections.
files.logs/resolution.txt:
09:40 Config rolled back to pool size 50.
09:44 Error rate returned to normal (<0.5%).
10:30 Postmortem scheduled; a config validation check will be added to the deploy pipeline.
